headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: Notion AI can access workspace pages while Taipy is a local/open-source data tool with no documented shared channel.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Notion AI can read workspace pages and team knowledge base content, so malicious text in shared pages could influence its outputs. Taipy has no documented ingestion path from Notion, no MCP, and no shared channel is shown, so the pairwise prompt-injection pathway is limited and likely requires manual copy/paste or other unusual bridging.
conditions: IF a user copies Notion AI output into Taipy prompts or configs
IF both agents are connected through a shared workspace or clipboard not shown in the profiles
mitigations: Disable copy-paste of untrusted workspace text into Taipy inputs
Add a short review step before Taipy consumes any Notion-generated text
Use explicit delimiters for instructions versus content
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging between Notion exports and Taipy ingestion

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion AI touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while Taipy is open-source with no documented data-handling or isolation controls in the profile. Because Notion uses vendor backends and downstream model providers, sensitive workspace content can leave the workspace; the pairwise leakage risk is plausible in default use, though Taipy itself has no documented egress.
conditions: IF workspace pages contain sensitive team content
IF Taipy is used to process or display exports from Notion without redaction
mitigations: Restrict Notion pages used by the pair to non-sensitive content
Redact secrets before exporting any Notion content
Confirm Taipy runs on local-only data paths
Document which data classes may flow from Notion into Taipy
requires-engineering: enforce DLP on Notion exports

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Notion AI has no host execution, no filesystem write, and no git modification, while Taipy's profile exposes no write or network capabilities beyond none. With no overlapping mutable resource or shared write surface documented, direct capability conflict is not evident; uncertainty is low because the profiles themselves block the main conflict modes.
conditions: IF Taipy is deployed with external write plugins not shown in the profile
IF a shared mutable workspace is introduced outside the documented surfaces
mitigations: Keep Taipy isolated from shared writable directories
Avoid granting extra filesystem or git permissions
Review any added plugins before deployment

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, so its outputs may be treated as authoritative summaries. Taipy is a data-engineering/automation tool, which can amplify bad upstream facts into downstream actions if its pipeline consumes Notion output without verification. The pairwise pathway exists, but no direct action authority is documented for Taipy here.
conditions: IF Taipy pipelines consume Notion-generated text as source data
IF no validation step checks Notion summaries before downstream use
mitigations: Insert a human review step before Taipy acts on Notion output
Validate structured fields against source records
Mark Notion text as untrusted input in Taipy pipelines
Log provenance for any Notion-derived records
requires-engineering: add schema validation gates

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI processes workspace pages and team knowledge base content through vendor backends, while Taipy has no documented residency, retention, or certification controls in the profile. That creates a compliance mismatch risk for regulated content if the pair is used together, but the evidence does not show a specific residency violation or PHI handling, so medium is the higher justified severity.
conditions: IF regulated data such as EU PII or PHI is placed into Notion pages
IF Taipy stores or forwards that data under a different retention policy
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair unless policies are confirmed
Map data residency and retention for both tools
Add a deletion/export process for Notion-derived records
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA and compliance review
